meeting_info.meeting_title: Smart Building IoT System - Requirements Review

discussion_summary: Noura started the session by reviewing the draft requirements document prepared by Fatima. Ibrahim highlighted that three of the proposed sensor types were not compatible with the current building network infrastructure and would require additional cabling work estimated at 3 weeks. James confirmed that the vendor can supply compatible alternatives but lead time is 6 weeks from order placement. Abdullah emphasized that energy reporting must align with the Saudi Green Building Standard requirements and requested this be added as a mandatory functional requirement. The team discussed data privacy concerns around occupancy tracking sensors and agreed that anonymized aggregated data only would be collected in common areas. Fatima flagged that the current requirements document does not address system behavior during network outages and requested Ibrahim to define the offline fallback behavior before next meeting.
decisions: Alternative sensor types from vendor approved subject to cost confirmation
Energy reporting module must comply with Saudi Green Building Standard
Occupancy tracking limited to anonymized aggregated data in common areas only
Offline fallback behavior to be defined and added to requirements before sign-off
Procurement process to start immediately to account for 6-week hardware lead time

action_items.task: Update requirements document with Saudi Green Building Standard alignment
Define system offline fallback behavior specification
Submit hardware quotation for alternative sensor types
Initiate procurement approval process for hardware order
Confirm cabling work schedule with facilities team
